description: This file defines the Response class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace. The class inherits from a JSONRPC message class and provides methods to access response ID, check if it is a result or error, retrieve result or error objects, and validate the response.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response message for WebSocket communications, providing accessors for response data and validation.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the response message.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result object from the response if available.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response contains an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error object from the response if available.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates if the response message is well-formed and appropriate.
